description: This PHP source file handles the display logic for detailed user role information within the ACLRoles module of SuiteCRM. It retrieves user data, manages access control categories, assigns variables to the Smarty templating engine, and renders the user role detail view including subpanels.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: A class used to manage and render subpanel layouts within the SuiteCRM interface.

methods.name: newBean
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate new bean objects of a specified module.

methods.name: getUserActions
methods.description: Returns the list of user actions for a specific user, used for access control management.

methods.name: setupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Prepares a matrix representation of categories for access control display.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates the standard module title for display on the interface.
